source_note: 给模1均匀分布的序列增加一个算术平均值渐近为0的序列
english_source_note: Adding a Vanishing-Cesaro Sequence to a Uniformly Distributed One
callout_id: 给模1均匀分布的序列增加一个算术平均值渐近为0的序列#1
statement_en: If $x_n$ is a sequence uniformly distributed modulo $1$, and $y_n$ satisfies $\sum_{n\leq N} |y_n|=o(N)$, then $x_n+y_n$ is also uniformly distributed modulo $1$.
key_techniques: perturbation by a sequence with vanishing average absolute value
callout_body: 如果$x_n$是模1均匀分布的序列，并且$y_n$满足$\sum_{n\leq N} |y_n|=o(N)$那么$x_n+y_n$也是模1均匀分布的序列。
